name: Vegan Paprika Bratwurst
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Gluten flour (see the seitan recipe for how to extract gluten from wheat flour)
Additional spices (e.g. coriander, cardamom, thyme and oregano)

steps: Cut onions and bell peppers in small chunks. If desired, fry the onions and peppers lightly.

Mix bell peppers, paprika powder, and chilies or chili powder into the dry gluten powder. It is much easier to mix solid and liquid ingredients separately than adding ingredients to the gluten dough later, as it is very rubbery and sticky.
To fry the sausages, an oiled non-stick pan is recommended. To fry the sausages on a grill, they must be cooked first in order to make the gluten dough less rubbery.

culture.text: Bratwurst is a type of German sausage made from pork or, less commonly, beef, veal, or any combination of beef, veal, and pork. The name is derived from the Old High German Brätwurst, from brät-, finely chopped meat, and Wurst, sausage, although in modern German it is often associated with the verb braten, to pan fry or roast.
